learning_outcomes.text: The student analyzes an existing interface on various aspects, both analog and digital, static and dynamic.
The student knows the different components and functions of an interface.
The student understands the operation of the constituent components and functions of an interface.

syllabus_topics: Parallel ports, possibilities and use: Input characteristics, Output characteristics (OC and Totem Pole), Buffering
Timers: Time adjustment, Auto reload configuration, Capture mode, PWM, Frequency measurement, Period measurement
A/D: Input protection/scaling, Sample&hold, Types of converters (Flash -SAR -SERVO -Integrating types), Resolution/accuracy, References
Introduction to data communication: UART (software, hardware), IIC, SPI, IR, Wireless
Displays: LED (static/multiplexing), LCD alphanumeric, LCD graphic, VFD, Magnetic
Fail-safe mechanisms for hardware and software
assessment_rules: The assessment is a written exam during the examination period, consisting of multiple-choice questions and open questions. The grading scale is 1-20. For resits, the same conditions apply as for the first examination opportunity. There are no partial transfers for this course.
